expectedRedSeal.cause: tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_execution is absent at each dynamic import; collection succeeds and no unrelated failure exists

writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

publicContract.constructor: ExecutionController(runtime_root, admission_adapter, provider, stage_runner, durability_ops=None, boundary_hook=None)
publicContract.method: execute(slot_key, issue_date, authority, payload, observed_at) returns RECONCILE_EXECUTION_RESULT_V1
publicContract.error: ExecutionError exposes exact .reason and, for child failures, .stage

authority: require the exact EXECUTION_AUTHORITY_V1 field set and canonical authoritySha256
read the current S1 control ledger and require an ACTIVE slot whose schedule/date/slot/generation/owner/fence and unexpired lease match
syntactic/schema/hash mismatch is AUTHORITY_INVALID; a well-formed authority that no longer matches current S1 state is STALE_FENCE
validate once before any S2 mutation and again immediately before COMMITTED
durableState: use one separate real SQLite control/execution-ledger-v1.sqlite3; do not change the exact S1 ledger schema
use UNIQUE execution identity bound to issueDate+slotKey+authoritySha256+payload hash and UNIQUE transition sequence/state ordering
persist an exact monotonic prefix PENDING,RESERVED,INTENT_DURABLE,DISPATCHED,CONFIRMED,COMMITTED in a table with columns sequence and state
persist admission decision, idempotency key, dispatch attempt count, confirmed receipt, completed stages and checkpoint bindings so restart needs no process memory
SQLite transactions use busy timeout, foreign keys, synchronous FULL and a bounded atomic transaction for every transition
admission: derive one deterministic idempotency key from execution identity and call admission_adapter only when no durable decision exists
validate exact HIGH_COST_ADMISSION_DECISION_V1 fields and decisionSha256 plus authority/idempotency equality
GRANTED appends RESERVED once; DENIED,UNAVAILABLE,malformed map to their exact typed reasons with provider count zero
a retry reuses the durable GRANTED decision and never calls admission again
checkpoints: stage order is exactly harvest,model,finalize; call stage_runner for every stage, including model preparation/validation
model is the only provider-owned high-cost external effect and occurs after its stage_runner succeeds
write exact hashed JSON checkpoints under control/execution-checkpoints/<execution-id>/<stage>.json using temp, injected fsync, atomic replace and parent flush; clean temp on failure
persist the checkpoint binding in SQLite only after the final checkpoint is durable
on resume every durable completed-stage row must have a present exact-valid checkpoint; missing and corrupt are distinct typed failures with no new provider effect
skip all valid completed stages; a child failure records no completion for that stage and retry starts there without replaying earlier stages
externalState: invoke boundary_hook at before_ and after_ each of INTENT_DURABLE,DISPATCHED,CONFIRMED,COMMITTED; after hooks run only after the corresponding durable transition
append INTENT_DURABLE before dispatch eligibility and DISPATCHED before provider.dispatch
when durable state is DISPATCHED, query the provider before any resend

PRESENT validates and persists the receipt; AMBIGUOUS or UNAVAILABLE raises RESULT_UNKNOWN without resend; ABSENT may call dispatch again only with the same key and only while dispatch attempts are below authority.maxDispatchAttempts
provider ExternalResultUnknown leaves DISPATCHED durable and raises RESULT_UNKNOWN
validate exact EXTERNAL_RESULT_RECEIPT_V1 confirmation, same idempotency key and lowercase 64-hex effectHash before CONFIRMED
write the model checkpoint after CONFIRMED, run/finalize its checkpoint, revalidate S1 authority, then append COMMITTED
an already COMMITTED execution returns the same terminal projection without admission, stage or provider calls
result: return exact RECONCILE_EXECUTION_RESULT_V1 with status, executionId, issueDate, slotKey, authoritySha256, idempotencyKey, externalState, completedStages, checkpoint hashes, external receipt and dispatchAttempts
externalState is COMMITTED only after the fence recheck and durable COMMITTED transition

verification.security: NEWS_GRASP_CLEANROOM_SECURITY_SCAN_V1 exact new path; denied/private/secret/external/network counts zero
other: git diff --name-only equals the one-file lease

causalRetryCondition: one implementation attempt and one ordered verification chain; return to Sol on the first non-Green for causal replan
delivery: one production file, hash/bytes, commit and exact verification evidence
